text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhhhhh!!
*sniff* That's so amaaaziiiingg!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Arriving at the cafeteria, a familiar crying sound could be heard echoing...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, waaah!
I'm so moooved!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Auuuugh, Trainerrr!!
Ah, auuugh, hawawaaa~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No, seriously, I have no idea what you're saying.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket's Trainer, don't worry.
It's just her usual habit of getting overly emotional.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The three of us were just reading
a magazine feature on 'Racing Racewear', but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "She seems to have been quite impressed by that interview."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Because... when I think about how everyone puts so many feelings into their outfits as they run...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It just reminded me of the first time
I put on my racing outfit... *waaaahhh*!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, you were seriously so annoying back then...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look look look look look!!
My racing outfit arrived~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So noisy... One look is all it takes to know.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it suits you remarkably well.
One could truly call it a racing outfit made just for you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right, right, totally, right?!
It just feels so natural!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey, what about you, Taishin!?
Don't you have any thoughts on it~~!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~~k!?
Taishin, seriously--

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You've got great eyes~~!
Yes, exactly, this shade of red is so cute~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Even after that, at every little thing it was always Racewear, Racewear, Racewear... And she cried every single time, too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I was so, so happy back then!
I mean, it's my very own Racewear, you know?!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Just imagining myself running on the stage of my dreams in that outfit
gives me chills...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*... I'm just so moved~~~!!
I thought to myself, I just have to, have to win~~!!
choice_data_list: I'm sure the other rivals feel the same way
Let's turn that emotion into strength.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Y-You're right...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The girls featured in the magazines,
Hayahide, Taixin too...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's so thrilled to wear their Racewear, and that's why they push so hard!
I'm not the only one getting power from it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuu!
I can't just sit around doing nothing--!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Where are you going, Ticket?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Training... Wait, AAAAAAHHH?!
I totally forgot!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Things just can't start
without you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean,
forget the Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
That straightforwardness is so like you, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer-san!
Let's have another great day today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...!
*sniff*... Yeah, you're right...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Allllllllllriiiighttt!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Kh!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I am gonna...
give it my absoluteeeeee best~~~~!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And then, and then...! I'm gonna move everyone to tears on that dream stage~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
T-Ticket, keep your voice down a bit.
Everyone is staring at us...

text_block_list.name: Voices Nearby
text_block_list.text: W-What a loud voice... Is it some kind of performance...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Oh, right, it was at the cafeteria--!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa-wa!! Um, I'm sorry for making a fuss—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Clap... clap clap clap...
clap clap clap...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? Are they clapping for me?
I don't really get it, but—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks a bunch~!
I'm gonna do my best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*.
Good grief...
